study type: Observational, retrospective, cross-sectional, and analytical study
outcome: Success rate of B-Lynch technique in controlling postpartum hemorrhage
Factors related to the indication of the B-Lynch technique
cohort: 104 patients who underwent hemostatic suture using the B-Lynch technique between January 1, 2005, and December 31, 2019
finding: The B-Lynch technique for postpartum hemorrhage was associated with few complications and a 95.2% success rate.
mod_finding: This study examined the effectiveness of the B-Lynch technique in managing postpartum hemorrhage and included previous cesarean section as a factor, but did not directly compare different modes of delivery.
